title: Law to make it easier to seal shops selling unsafe e-bikes
summary: This bill would let the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection or the Fire Department seal a retailer's premises after just two safety violations within two years, instead of the current three violations within three years, for selling unsafe powered bicycles, mobility devices or batteries. It is one of several bills the Council is considering after a sharp rise in lithium-ion battery fires, which caused 400 incidents and 12 deaths so far in 2026.
